RC1 · A REVIEW COPY FOR A DESIGNER

Dear reader, would you read two chapters?

From the editor of The ultimate insider, a book about one day in which one person and a team of AI agents built a talk, with the record to prove it.

Why you
You make long arguments readable for a living. Where a picture should replace a paragraph here, or a paragraph a picture, you will see it before anyone else.
What we would like
Two chapters, about 33 minutes, by Friday 13 November 2026 (an example date: nothing has been sent), and your answers to a few questions at the end of each.
What you get back
your name in the acknowledgements, if you want it there
the first edition when it ships
a reply to every comment, and a page showing what your comments changed
